name: Sumo deadlift
cue: Wide stance, toes out, hands inside the knees; push the knees out and the floor away, hips through at the top.

name: Close-grip bench press
cue: Hands just inside shoulder width, elbows tucked, bar to the lower chest, press to lockout.

name: Skullcrusher (lying triceps extension)
cue: Lying on a bench, bar or EZ bar over the face, lower to the forehead by bending only the elbows, extend.

name: Dumbbell chest fly
cue: Flat bench, slight elbow bend, open the arms wide to a chest stretch, squeeze back up in an arc.

name: Calf raise
cue: Standing on a block or machine, full stretch at the bottom, pause on the toes at the top.

name: Seated calf raise
cue: Knees bent under the pad, drop the heels for a full stretch, rise onto the toes and pause.

name: Calf press (leg press)
cue: Feet low on the leg-press plate, legs straight, push through the balls of the feet, full stretch at the bottom.

name: Inverted row
cue: Hang under a bar or rings, body straight, pull the chest to the bar and lower under control. Lower the bar or raise the feet to make it harder.

name: Nordic curl
cue: Kneel with the ankles anchored, lower the body forward with straight hips as slowly as possible, pull back up (use a band or a push off the floor to assist).

name: Deadbug
cue: On the back, arms up and knees over hips; lower the opposite arm and leg while keeping the lower back pressed into the floor.

name: Arch hang
cue: Hang from the bar, pull the shoulder blades down and back, chest up into an arch, hold or repeat.

name: Support hold (parallel bars)
cue: Lock the arms out on parallel bars or rings, shoulders pushed down away from the ears, hold.

name: Reverse hyperextension
cue: Hips on the edge of a bench or box, upper body supported, lift straight legs up to horizontal with the glutes and lower back, lower slowly.

name: Pallof press
cue: Cable or band at chest height from the side, press the hands straight out and hold against the twist, bring back. Both sides.

name: Band shoulder dislocates
cue: Wide grip on a band or stick, arms straight, take it over the head and behind, then back to the front.
